name: Frejon and Mango Cream Pie
author: Yewande Komolafe
description: A popular dish in Lagos, Nigeria, frejon combines beans and coconut milk into a puree that can go sweet or savory. Here, a nutmeg- and clove-scented take on the sweet version is blended with coconut yogurt to become as creamy as a smoothie. Spread into a gingersnap crust, layered with fresh mango and topped with whipped coconut cream, the result is a dessert that’s sort of like banana cream pie. This pie is dairy-free, but if you can’t find sweetened condensed coconut milk or coconut yogurt and you’re OK with dairy, you can use sweetened condensed milk and coconut-flavored dairy yogurt instead.

ingredients.raw: 1 (15.5-ounce) can coconut cream, chilled
1 (1-inch) piece fresh ginger, peeled and grated
2 limes, zested and juiced (about ¼ cup juice)
ingredients.preparation: zested and juiced (about ¼ cup juice)

ingredients.raw: 1 cup/146 grams pitted Medjool dates, chopped, divided
1 ½ cups/217 grams 1 ½ inch mango chunks (from 1 to 2 mangos)
ingredients.item: cups/217 grams 1 ½ inch mango chunks (from 1 to 2 mangos)

ingredients.raw: 4 cups/198 grams ginger snaps, broken into pieces
¼ cup coconut palm sugar or dark brown sugar
ingredients.item: coconut palm sugar or dark brown sugar

ingredients.raw: 2 teaspoons kosher salt (such as Diamond Crystal), divided
½ cup unrefined coconut oil
1 (15.5-ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
1 (7.4-ounce) can sweetened condensed coconut milk
1 cup/236 grams coconut yogurt
½ teaspoon ground cloves
1 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg, plus more for serving
½ teaspoon ground black pepper, plus more to taste

steps.text: Turn the chilled can of coconut cream upside down and open it. There should be a layer of liquid on top. (If there isn’t, push aside the hardened cream to reveal it.) Pour the liquid into a small bowl and set aside. Scrape the thick coconut cream in the can into a medium bowl. Cover the cream and refrigerate until ready to whip for serving.

In another medium bowl, combine the ginger, lime zest and juice and ¼ cup chopped dates. Break up any dates that are stuck together, tossing to coat with the lime juice. Fold in the mango and season lightly with salt and pepper. Set aside.

Place the gingersnaps, sugar and 1 teaspoon salt in a blender and pulse to crush into dust with some crumbs. Tip the mixture into a 9-inch pie pan, add the coconut oil and mix in the oil until evenly distributed. The mixture should look like chunky sand. Use your fingers or the flat side of a cup to press the mixture against the bottom and up the sides of the pan.
Make space in the freezer for the pan to sit flat. Spread the mango mixture in an even layer over the crust and freeze.

While the mango freezes, use a blender to pulse the beans and remaining ¾ cup dates with the sweetened condensed milk, yogurt, cloves, nutmeg, black pepper, 1 teaspoon salt and reserved coconut cream liquid on low to break up the solids. Then puree on high, scraping down the sides as needed, until completely smooth. Work in batches if necessary. You should end up with about 3 cups of purée.

Remove the pan from the freezer and pour the bean purée over the fruit layer. Even out the surface with the back of a spoon; the pan will be filled to the rim. Cover with plastic wrap and freeze until completely firm, at least 4 hours and up to 10 hours.

Remove the chilled coconut cream from the refrigerator. Use an electric mixer on medium-high speed to beat it until smooth and fluffy. Mound the whipped cream over the frozen pie and swirl. Grate nutmeg over the top. Cut in wedges and serve immediately.

name: French Green Beans and Shallots
author: Jacques Pépin
description: These are perfect green beans: simple and elegant. They go with almost anything, and are delicious with roast chicken.

ingredients.raw: 4 cups water
1 pound very small, firm green beans, cleaned
3 tablespoons butter
3 tablespoons peeled and chopped shallots
¼ teaspoon salt, or to taste
¼ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, or to taste
1 teaspoon lemon juice

steps.text: Bring the water to a boil. Add the beans and cover the pot. Continue cooking the beans, covered, for 3 to 5 minutes until tender but firm. Drain and rinse under cold water.
At serving time, heat the butter in a skillet, add the shallots and saute for about 1 minute, until the shallots start to brown.
Add the beans, salt and pepper, and saute briefly. Sprinkle with lemon juice and serve with the chicken.

name: Fresh Bean Curd With Sweet Scallion Sauce
author: Molly O’Neill

ingredients.raw: 2 tablespoons pine nuts
6 cups cold water
4 cakes fresh bean curd (tofu)
½ scallion, green part only, thinly sliced
¼ cup scallion oil
¼ cup dark soy sauce
¼ cup vegetable broth (chicken broth may be substituted)
ingredients.item: vegetable broth (chicken broth may be substituted)

ingredients.raw: 2 tablespoons sugar

steps.text: To make the bean curd, heat a wok or heavy skillet over high heat for 30 seconds. Turn the heat very low. Add the pine nuts and spread in a single layer. Cook, stirring often with a spatula, until the nuts turn brown, about 12 minutes. Set aside.

To make the sauce, heat a wok or heavy skillet over medium heat. Add the scallion oil, soy sauce, broth and sugar. Stir clockwise (to avoid spattering) until all ingredients are well blended and begin to boil. Set aside.

Place water in a large pot, cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Add bean curd and boil for 4 minutes. Drain well, cut each cake in half crosswise and place in a heated dish. Whisk the sauce and pour over bean curd. Sprinkle with pine nuts and scallion and serve immediately.

ingredients.raw: 18 ears fresh corn, husk and silk removed
4 scallions, sliced
3 large red bell peppers, cut into ½-inch dice
3 large green peppers, cut into ½-inch dice
3 cucumbers, peeled, seeded and chopped
½ cup chopped fresh dill
1 pint cherry tomatoes, sliced in half
1 ½ cups extra-virgin olive oil
½ cup balsamic vinegar
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
ingredients.item: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Slice the corn off the cobs into a very large bowl. In a large pot, bring about 2 quarts of water to boil. Add the corn kernels and cover. Bring to a boil and cook 4 minutes, stirring the corn once every minute and removing silk or husks. Drain and refresh under cold water. Put the corn in a large serving bowl with the remaining vegetables. Add the oil. Toss well. Add the vinegar and salt and pepper to taste and mix well. Marinate 1 to 2 hours.

name: Fresh Corn Summer Salad
author: Betty Fussell
description: Here is a bright bowl of summer offered up by Betty Fussell, the cookbook writer and observer of American life. She tells us to organize the vegetables in rows across a platter, which provides a lovely presentation — but there’s nothing wrong with piling them in a bowl willy-nilly, a crisp riot of color and flavor.

ingredients.raw: 3 cups fresh corn kernels (from about 5 ears)
¼ cup chopped scallions
2 small young zucchini (about ½ pound), diced
2 small ripe tomatoes (about ½ pound), seeded and diced
1 orange sweet bell pepper, seeded and diced
¼ pound green beans, parboiled 2 minutes and cut into ½-inch lengths
ingredients.preparation: parboiled 2 minutes and cut into ½-inch lengths

ingredients.raw: ½ cup packed basil leaves
1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped
1 clove garlic, minced
½ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tablespoons lime juice
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.item: salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps.text: In a medium bowl, combine the corn kernels and scallions, and transfer to one end of a serving platter. Place the zucchini, tomatoes, bell pepper and green beans in rows across the platter, until the platter is filled.

In the container of a blender, combine the basil leaves, jalapeno, garlic, olive oil and lime juice. Puree until smooth, and season to taste with salt and pepper. Pour the dressing over the vegetables, and serve.

name: Fresh Lima Bean and Romaine Lettuce Slaw With Orecchiette
author: Molly O’Neill

servings.text: 6 main course servings or 12 side-dish servings

ingredients.raw: 2 large ripe tomatoes, cut into small dice
½ cup minced chives
¼ cup minced, pitted green olives
2 tablespoons olive oil
2 cups fresh or frozen lima beans
2 teaspoons salt, plus more to taste
Freshly ground pepper to taste
½ pound orecchiette
4 cups romaine lettuce that has been cut across into thin strips
ingredients.item: romaine lettuce that has been cut across into thin strips

steps.text: In a large bowl, toss together the tomatoes, chives, olives and olive oil. Set aside. Cook the lima beans in simmering water until tender. Drain and add to the tomato mixture.

Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add the orecchiette and cook until al dente, about 10 minutes. Drain. Toss the warm pasta into the salad. Add the salt and pepper to taste. Toss in the lettuce and serve immediately.

name: Frisee Salad With Fish and Chips (Salmon and seaweed)
author: Nancy Harmon Jenkins

raw.total: 40 minutes plus 1 hour for marinating salmon
raw.prep: 20 minutes plus 1 hour for marinating salmon

ingredients.raw: ⅓ cup olive oil flavored with herbes de Provence, or best-quality extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.item: olive oil flavored with herbes de provence

ingredients.raw: 1 salmon fillet, preferably from a wild fish, weighing at least 1 pound
ingredients.preparation: preferably from a wild fish, weighing at least 1 pound

ingredients.raw: 1 ounce of dulse (see note)
3 tablespoons grape seed oil or other oil that tolerates high temperatures
ingredients.item: grape seed oil or other oil that tolerates high temperatures

ingredients.raw: 12 basil leaves preserved in oil (optional)
2 tablespoons sage vinegar or flavorful wine vinegar
ingredients.item: sage vinegar or flavorful wine vinegar

ingredients.raw: 3 tablespoons basil vinegar or flavorful wine vinegar
ingredients.item: basil vinegar or flavorful wine vinegar

ingredients.raw: 8 tablespoons basil oil or best-quality extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.item: basil oil or best-quality extra-virgin olive oil

ingredients.raw: Pinch of salt
Freshly ground black pepper to taste
ingredients.item: freshly ground black pepper to taste

ingredients.raw: 2 tablespoons creme fraiche (see note)
⅓ cup finely slivered fresh chives
2 bunches curly endive or chicory frisee, rinsed and dried

steps.text: Rub the ⅓ cup of olive oil into the salmon and set aside to marinate at least 1 hour. Preheat grill or broiler to high heat and grill salmon 3 minutes to a side, until it is thoroughly seared on the outside but barely warm in the center. Remove from heat and set aside.

To prepare the dulse, first peel and stretch the pieces to separate them. Heat the grape seed oil in a skillet over high heat until oil is smoking. Add the pieces of seaweed a few at a time to the smoking oil. They will curl flat and brown almost immediately. Remove from heat, drain on paper towels and set aside. Saute basil leaves; drain and set aside. Sprinkle the sage vinegar over the seaweed and basil.

To prepare the salad cream, first whisk together the vinegar and oil. Add salt and pepper. Beat in creme fraiche until mixture is thoroughly homogeneous and creamy. Add chives just before serving. Pour over the endive and toss to mix and coat the leaves completely.
To serve, put a mound of greens on each plate. Cut the salmon in very thin slices and distribute on top of each salad mound. Sprinkle the salmon slices with seaweed "chips" and serve immediately.
